h1: New Braunfels forestry mulching on both sides of the Balcones Fault
lede: 9 Arrow Land Service handles forestry mulching in New Braunfels, TX, from the cedar hills on the west side of town to the open ground on the east. We pick the machine for the ground and grind growth where it stands.

answer.q: How does forestry mulching work in New Braunfels, TX?
answer.a: Forestry mulching in New Braunfels, TX grinds trees and brush where they stand, with no pushing, piling, hauling or burning. On the Hill Country side of town, compact track machines handle slopes and limestone. On open ground, large articulated wheel machines bring higher production. Either way, the result is a fine mulch finish.

highlights: Compact track and articulated wheel machines
GPS-guided lot line and survey clearing
Fine finish that is easy to drive over

sections.h2: Hill Country and prairie ground in New Braunfels
paras: New Braunfels is the county seat of Comal County and reaches into Guadalupe County. The city sits on the Balcones Fault, where the Texas Hill Country meets rolling prairie land. The Comal River rises from Comal Springs in town, the Guadalupe River runs through it, and I-35, State Highway 46 and Loop 337 carry most of the traffic.

Those two landscapes give New Braunfels two kinds of clearing jobs. West of the fault, land looks like the rest of the Hill Country, with limestone, slopes, Ashe juniper and live oaks. East of the fault, the ground flattens into prairie, with deeper soils and brush and mesquite scattered across wider tracts.

sections.h2: Matching the forestry mulcher to New Braunfels ground
paras: Machine choice on a New Braunfels job comes down to slope, access and how much ground there is to cover.
bullets: West-side slopes and wooded lots get compact track machines, which handle tight access, slopes and uneven ground.
Open acreage gets large articulated wheel machines with high horsepower and high production.
Smaller machines cover about half an acre to an acre in an 8-hour day. Larger machines cover about 1 to 3 acres a day with reasonable tree coverage, and up to 5 in lighter conditions.

sections.h2: Forestry mulching lot lines and pad sites in New Braunfels
paras: On development land around New Braunfels, clearing usually starts with a surveyor's plat. Our [survey line clearing](precision-line-survey-clearing) runs on Trimble GPS receivers mounted on the mulchers and loaded with your licensed surveyor's CAD files. sections.h2: Big trees and the finish we leave
paras: Forestry mulching has no tree size limit. A large hardwood that takes an hour on a smaller machine can go down in as little as 15 minutes on a large one, so machine choice matters on New Braunfels tracts with mature trees.

The finish is fine, small material our crews call toothpicks. A fine finish is easier to drive over than a rough one, grass comes back faster, and the mulch can be stockpiled or hauled off if your plans call for bare ground.

faqs.q: Is forestry mulching in New Braunfels different on the Hill Country side?
faqs.a: Yes, forestry mulching on the Hill Country side of New Braunfels usually means slopes, limestone and Ashe juniper, so compact track machines do more of the work. Flatter ground toward the prairie side suits large articulated wheel machines with higher production. The ground decides the machine, and the machine sets the pace.

faqs.q: Can you clear lot lines in New Braunfels from my surveyor's files?
faqs.a: Yes, 9 Arrow clears lot lines in New Braunfels from your licensed surveyor's CAD files. Trimble GPS receivers on our mulchers follow the certified survey data in real time, which reduces or eliminates pre-staking by the survey crew. We are not surveyors, and the line still comes from your surveyor.

faqs.q: What happens to stumps after forestry mulching in New Braunfels?
faqs.a: Forestry mulching in New Braunfels grinds each tree down and leaves the root ball in the ground, which keeps the soil stable. Where full removal is needed, such as under a foundation, we grub with bulldozers and excavators. Our preferred next step is to mulch those root balls right on site.
